// CASE swift_while_index expect=fire
func a(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  var i = 0
  while i < items.count {
    try await save(items[i])
    i += 1
  }
}
// CASE swift_repeat_while expect=fire
func b(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  var i = 0
  repeat {
    try await save(items[i])
    i += 1
  } while i < items.count
}
// CASE swift_async_let_in_loop expect=fire
func c(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  for item in items {
    async let result = save(item)
    try await result
  }
}
// CASE swift_enumerated expect=fire
func d(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  for (index, item) in items.enumerated() {
    try await save(index, item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_while_pop expect=fire
func e(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  var queue = items
  while let item = queue.popLast() {
    try await save(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_for_where expect=fire
func f(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  for item in items where item > 0 {
    try await save(item)
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
